baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus predicates da'imun of salatihim through the construction 'ala salatihim.
baseline_models.mechanism: Prescribed worship is the object of stable remaining, so the line marks a durable practice rather than a one-off performance.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the concrete practice whose continuity the focus predicates.
Stable remaining and steady practice supply the temporal mode of that worship.

changed_reading.after: They remain steadily committed to the prescribed practice of prayer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Salatihim at focus word 4 is held together with da'imun at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The supplication, praise, and mercy branch makes continuity relational: the practice repeatedly keeps asking, blessing, and receptivity to mercy in motion.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, praise, and mercy widen prayer from posture to an ongoing relational act.
Stable continuance makes that relational orientation durable rather than occasional.

changed_reading.after: They keep open a durable channel of supplication, praise, blessing, and mercy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Da'imun modifies prayer while the 'ala construction presents prayer as a position they remain upon.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hovering or circling branch permits continuity to be modeled as recurrent return around a fixed center, not as literally uninterrupted activity.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship provides the fixed center of repeated return.
Hovering or circling as if paused supplies an orbit-like image for durable recurrence.

changed_reading.after: Their prayer is a stable orbit: repeated return around an orienting center even between performances.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding human pattern is touch-triggered switching: disturbance under harm and withholding under good. Stable prayer therefore reads as interruption resistance rather than frequency alone.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the repeatable practice opposed to reactive switching.
Stable continuance supplies resistance to event-driven interruption.
Anxious greed and rapid disturbance define the unstable baseline that prayer interrupts.
An impact reaching the person makes harm an external trigger for reaction.
The repeated impact image makes good the matching trigger for the opposite reaction.
Patience being cut off supplies the failure of endurance under harm.
The hand withheld from giving supplies the self-closing reaction under good.

structural_cues: 70:19-21 forms a two-case trigger sequence, and 70:22 immediately excepts the praying group before the focus explains them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disturbance, paired impacts, broken patience, withholding, and the exception; I infer that repeated prayer trains resistance to this switching. Alternatively, prayer may identify the exempt group without being presented as its cause.

changed_reading.after: Constancy means maintaining a prayer-shaped response across harm and benefit instead of being reprogrammed by each touch.

context_deltas.mechanism: What appears externally stable loses form: elevated matter becomes molten residue and a hard mass becomes soft dyed wool. Da'imun relocates stability from surroundings into repeated practice.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies a portable practice that persists through changed conditions.
Stable remaining transfers continuity from environment to disciplined subject.
Molten substances and residue supply matter losing stable form.
A high solid mass supplies the strongest ordinary image of external stability.
Soft dyed wool supplies the mountain's transformed, dispersible state.

structural_cues: The paired similes in 70:8-9 transform sky and mountains before the focus names a durable human practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material phase changes and stable continuance; I infer that prayer becomes portable stability when the world is unstable. Alternatively, the cosmic images may function only as warning.

changed_reading.before: They maintain prayer under normal conditions.
changed_reading.after: They carry stability in the practice itself when even elevated and solid surroundings lose form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restraint bridges opposed estimates of distance: humans see the event as remote while the divine viewpoint presents it as near. Continual prayer keeps conduct aligned with the longer horizon rather than felt delay.

activation_trace.role: Temporal duration and steady practice supply long-horizon discipline.
Holding the self back from broken patience supplies the posture needed across delay.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the human estimate that can relax present conduct.
Temporal nearness supplies the correcting horizon toward which practice is calibrated.

structural_cues: 70:4 gives a fifty-thousand-year measure, followed by the far/near viewpoint reversal in 70:6-7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, a vast measure, and opposed distance estimates; I infer that continual prayer operationalizes the corrected horizon. Alternatively, the patience command and prayer description may remain independent responses.

changed_reading.after: Da'imun describes temporal calibration: prayer keeps the apparently distant future behaviorally near.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the exception, condemned motion turns away, gathers, and encloses; immediately after enduring prayer, wealth contains an established claim for requester and deprived person. Prayer stands at the hinge between closed accumulation and reliable outward allocation.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, praise, and mercy supply the relational opening that counters self-enclosure.
Stable continuance makes outward relation a reliable flow rather than a sporadic gesture.
Turning the back supplies relational closure before the prayer exception.
Joining scattered goods into one accumulation supplies inward material motion.
Putting a thing into a container supplies accumulation sealed against circulation.
Possessing and increasing wealth supplies the stock from which allocation moves.
A specific right owned by its holder makes distribution an entitlement.
Asking and requesting supply the visible claimant toward whom the flow opens.
Deprivation supplies the claimant whose need may remain unvoiced.

structural_cues: 70:17-18 closes with gathering and enclosing, while 70:24-25 opens wealth to a known right on the other side of the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies closure before prayer and a fixed outward claim after it; I infer that prayer is the hinge regularizing circulation. Alternatively, these may be parallel marks of one character rather than a causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: Continual prayer is a private devotional achievement.
changed_reading.after: Continual prayer keeps devotion and goods from closing around the self, issuing in a dependable right toward voiced and unvoiced need.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opens the trait sequence with persistence upon prayer, while 70:34 closes it with guarding prayer. The pair distinguishes temporal recurrence from attentive custodianship.

activation_trace.role: Stable remaining supplies the opening temporal axis of prayer.
The repeated prescribed-worship object makes the closing line comparable to the focus.
Adhering to and attending an affair supply active custodianship in addition to duration.

structural_cues: 70:23 and 70:34 repeat the construction they are upon their prayer as bookends around the intervening obligations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constructional repetition with different predicates; I infer a two-axis bookend of duration and preservation. Alternatively, the close may simply reinforce the opening.

changed_reading.before: Continuity alone exhausts the description of their prayer.
changed_reading.after: Prayer has two demands: durable recurrence at the opening and attentive preservation at the close.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant prayer mapping carries heating and straightening. Against molten matter, stripping force, and turning away before the blaze, sustained prayer can be carried as voluntary formative exposure before destructive exposure.

activation_trace.role: Kindling and fire-straightening supply the focus-side analogy of controlled formation.
Steady practice makes formative exposure sustained rather than momentary.
Molten substances and residue supply uncontrolled heat and phase change.
Uprooting a thing from its place supplies destructive stripping.
Turning the back supplies refusal of formative orientation.

structural_cues: The rootless 70:15 names the blaze and is used only as a structural cue between molten-sky and stripping images.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split-root fire-straightening image and melting, stripping, and turning away; I supply the arrow from regular prayer to voluntary formation. Alternatively, this branch should remain metaphorical rather than lexical.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is simply maintained over time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, maintained prayer is controlled formative heat: repeated exposure that straightens before uncontrolled heat strips away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant D-W-M to D-M-W blood mapping rather than ordinary continuance. It remains anchored to focus word 5 and gains a mechanism from the following wealth and entitlement sequence; render it only as material analogy, never as etymology or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 5 is split-mapped to the blood inventory, while focus word 4 supplies the mercy channel.

activation_trace.role: Blood itself supplies a circulation image for the non-dominant focus mapping.
Supplication and mercy supply the relational substance imagined as circulating.
Accumulated wealth supplies stock that must not remain socially stagnant.
A holder-owned right supplies the channel by which goods leave accumulation.
The request supplies one receiving endpoint of circulation.
Deprivation supplies the less visible endpoint circulation must still reach.

changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, continual prayer behaves like social circulation, moving mercy and due goods from accumulated stock toward need.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The horse-race follower branch is distant from ritual prayer, so this reading is surprising. It remains anchored to focus word 4 and is activated by precedence, speed, and a set marker; render it only as a directional metaphor, not as the sense of salat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 4 has an explicit branch image of the racer immediately following the leader, joined to stable continuance at word 5.

activation_trace.role: The follower just behind the leader supplies close, directed adherence.
Stable continuance makes following durable rather than a burst of speed.
Advancing in a race supplies the context's precedence axis.
Speed opposed to slowness supplies frantic pace without right direction.
A set boundary marker supplies the destination of rapid movement.

changed_reading.before: Prayer constancy is measured only by repeated frequency.
changed_reading.after: As a contained race metaphor, constancy is staying closely behind a legitimate lead; durable direction matters more than frantic speed.

strongest_changes: The immediate exception recasts continuity as resistance to harm/good-triggered switching, not frequency alone.
The enclosing sequence before the focus and fixed-right sequence after it make prayer a hinge from private accumulation to circulation.
The repeated prayer construction at 70:34 separates durable recurrence from vigilant preservation.
summary.what_was_special: The two split focus inventories generated coexisting mechanisms: ritual durability, relational mercy, recurrent orbit, temporal calibration, portable stability, and contained material or directional analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The context juxtaposes prayer with stable conduct but does not explicitly state that prayer causes every downstream trait.
Da'imun may emphasize literal regularity more than the orbit-like recurrence model.
The fire, blood, and race readings depend on branch-distant or non-dominant mappings and must remain exploratory.
